# Illustration

Aleem spot illustrations: the solid mascot tile is the subject, props around it are duotone shapes from the icon set, a soft cyan glow sits behind.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Illustration` · Illustrations

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Illustration />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Illustration"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Aleem spot illustration: solid mascot tile plus duotone props from the icon set, tokens for every colour.

## Props (IllustrationProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | `"empty" \| "search" \| "error" \| "offline" \| "success" \| "connect" \| "invite" \| "launch" \| "not-found" \| "hero" \| "cover" \| "email"` | Which spot scene. empty / search for EmptyState; error / offline for Alert panels and 404-style pages; success after a flow; connect / invite / launch for on… |
| `width` | `number \| string` | Rendered width (px or CSS length). Height follows 4:3. 120 in small empty states, 200 default, 320+ in heroes and covers. @default 200 |
| `glow` | `boolean` | Cyan brand glow behind the scene. Turn off over a page that already has a glow. @default true |
| `onInk` | `boolean` | On-ink palette (light tile, cyan lines) for navy panels, dark slides, email headers. @default false |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible description when the scene carries meaning on its own. Omit when the title next to it already says it. |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement>, 'width'>._
